constraints.product: Weekly trend drops; Sub-Rs 999 core pricing; 3-5 day dispatch
constraints.price: Reflects the brand's real budget price posture.
constraints.place: Primarily direct-to-consumer via the brand's own site/app, discovered through Instagram/Reels-native content.
constraints.promotion: Creator/customer-style short-form video content tends to outperform polished static product imagery on engagement.
constraints.people: Talks like a friend hyping the next drop, not a catalog. Leans on countdowns, emoji, creator-style captions.
hard_rules: No discount code call-outs in the headline, we want this capsule to feel like a drop not a sale
Also nothing that implies limited stock we can't actually back - sizes run out but don't want a fake scarcity vibe if it's not real
And keep it Instagram/Reels-native, not stiff catalog copy.
Urgency/discount mechanics are on-brand and may be used, but must not misrepresent stock levels (no fake scarcity).
